# vcop: seeds for the Model 1 sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp).
# Addresses only, our own analysis (rules.md rule 7). The command dispatch is
# "movea.l #$f4e,A5; lsl.l #2,D2; jmp (A5,D2.l)" (0xf40-0xf48): a table of 128 jmp/bra
# entries, 4 bytes each, 0xf4e-0x114a; every entry is a seed. Then the starts of code
# MAME's 68000 executed (M2TRACE_SNDPCS: 8,000 frames of attract and a scripted
# 9,000-frame game) that the table's targets do not reach on their own.
